Myocardial contractility is the forced which act on ventricular contraction independent of preload or Afterload or HR.

The main determinant of contractility is the myocyte intracellular Ca concentration, which is regulated by the intracellular messenger cAMP

→ ↑cAMP → Protein Kinase A→ ↑Ca → ↑inotropy 

Myocardial excitation - contraction coupling occurs as follows:

1)  Action potential reaches cardiac myocyte 
2)  Ca2+ influx through L type calcium channels in the plasma membrane 
3)  Ca induced calcium released from sarcoplasmic reticulum via Ryanodine receptors
4)  Ca binds to troponin → conformation change and actin myosin interaction proceeds

Drugs which increase Contractility are inotropes:

+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Class**                        | **Example**        | **MOA**                                    |
+==================================+====================+============================================+
| **Direct B1 receptor agonist**   | Adrenaline         | GsPCR →↑cAMP →↑Ca2+                        |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  | Noradrenaline      |                                            |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  | Dopamine           |                                            |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Indirect B1 Receptor agonist** | Ephedrine          | ↑NA release at nerve terminal              |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Ca2+ Sensitiser**              | Levosimendan       | Binds to Troponin C →↑Ca2+ Sensitivity     |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Cardiac Glycosides**           | Digoxin            | Inhibits Na/K ATPase                       |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  |                    | →↑Intracellular Na                         |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  |                    | →↓Na/Ca exchange activity                  |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  |                    | → ↑intracellular Ca                        |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Phosphodiesterase inhibitors** | Milrinone  (PDE3)  | PDE3 inhibition →↓breakdown of cAMP →↑Ca2+ |
|                                  |                    |                                            |
|                                  | Aminophylline      |                                            |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Calcium**                      | Calcium            | ↑intracellular Ca                          |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
| **Glucagon **                    | Glucagon           | GsPCR →↑cAMP                               |
+----------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------------+
